sql_log.purpose: Discover complete JSON member shapes for the three frozen inventory arrays.
sql_log.sql:
with e as (select payload from public.lf_eventos where id=20161),
arrays as (
 select 'sql_callers' section, x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x
 union all
 select 'trigger_bindings', x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'trigger_bindings') x
 union all
 select 'external_inventory', x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'external_inventory') x
), keys as (
 select section,key,count(*) rows_with_key from arrays cross join lateral jsonb_object_keys(x) key group by section,key
)
select
 (select jsonb_object_keys(payload) from e limit 1) as one_payload_key,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('section',section,'key',key,'rows_with_key',rows_with_key) order by section,key) from keys) as section_keys,
 (select jsonb_agg(x order by x::text) from arrays where section='trigger_bindings') as trigger_bindings,
 (select jsonb_agg(x order by x::text) from arrays where section='external_inventory') as external_inventory

with e as (select payload from public.lf_eventos where id=20161),
c as (select x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x),
t as (select x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'trigger_bindings') x),
x as (select x from e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(payload->'external_inventory') x),
r as (select payload,receipt_sha256 from programacion.provenance_receipts where id=38)
select
 (select count(*) from c) sql_callers,
 (select count(distinct x->>'dedupe_key') from c) sql_caller_dedupe_keys,
 (select count(distinct x->>'caller') from c) sql_caller_names,
 (select count(distinct x->>'caller_oid') from c) sql_caller_oids,
 (select count(*) from c where x->>'caller' is null or x->>'caller_oid' is null or x->>'definition_md5' is null or x->'callees' is null) sql_required_field_gaps,
 (select count(*) from t) trigger_bindings,
 (select count(distinct x->>'dedupe_key') from t) trigger_dedupe_keys,
 (select count(distinct x->>'table_name') from t) trigger_tables,
 (select count(distinct x->>'trigger') from t) trigger_names,
 (select count(*) from t where x->>'table_name' is null or x->>'trigger' is null or x->>'function' is null or x->>'enabled' is null) trigger_required_field_gaps,
 (select count(*) from x) external_inventory,
 (select count(distinct x->>'dedupe_key') from x) external_dedupe_keys,
 (select count(distinct x->>'caller') from x) external_callers,
 (select count(*) from x where x->>'caller' is null or x->>'governance_lifecycle' is null) external_required_field_gaps,
 (select payload from r) receipt_payload,
 (select receipt_sha256 from r) receipt_sha256

sql_log.purpose: Resolve every frozen caller and trigger against the current catalog without invoking functions.
sql_log.sql:
with hc as (
 select x->>'caller' caller,split_part(x->>'caller','.',1) nspname,split_part(x->>'caller','.',2) proname,
        (x->>'caller_oid')::oid historical_oid
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x where e.id=20161
), cm as (
 select h.caller,h.historical_oid,count(p.oid) matches,bool_or(p.oid=h.historical_oid) same_oid,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('oid',p.oid,'identity',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname) order by p.oid) filter(where p.oid is not null) candidates
 from hc h left join pg_namespace n on n.nspname=h.nspname
 left join pg_proc p on p.pronamespace=n.oid and p.proname=h.proname
 group by h.caller,h.historical_oid
), ht as (
 select x->>'dedupe_key' dedupe_key,x->>'table_name' table_name,x->>'trigger' trigger_name,
        x->>'function' function_name,x->>'enabled' historical_enabled,
        split_part(x->>'table_name','.',1) table_schema,split_part(x->>'table_name','.',2) relation_name
 from public.lf_eventos e cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'trigger_bindings') x where e.id=20161
), tm as (
 select h.dedupe_key,h.table_name,h.trigger_name,h.function_name,h.historical_enabled,
        count(t.oid) matches,
        bool_or(t.tgenabled::text=h.historical_enabled) enabled_match,
        bool_or(fns.nspname||'.'||fp.proname||'()'=h.function_name) function_match,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trigger_oid',t.oid,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'function',fns.nspname||'.'||fp.proname||'()') order by t.oid) filter(where t.oid is not null) candidates
 from ht h

sql_log.purpose: Compare raw pre-cut screen/family observations to governed receipt 38 without treating raw counts as a substitute.
sql_log.sql:
with pre as (
 select * from programacion.input_readiness_runs where created_at<timestamptz '2026-10-15'
), screen_counts as (
 select pantalla_id,count(*) observations,count(*) filter(where status='COMPLETED') completed_observations
 from pre group by pantalla_id
), fam_counts as (
 select a.family_code,count(*) observations,count(*) filter(where r.status='COMPLETED') completed_observations
 from programacion.input_family_assessments a join pre r on r.id=a.run_id group by a.family_code
), receipt as (

)
select
 (select count(*) from pre) pre_cut_runs,
 (select count(*) from pre where status='COMPLETED') pre_cut_completed_runs,
 (select count(*) from screen_counts) pre_cut_screens,
 (select min(observations) from screen_counts) min_screen_observations_all,
 (select min(completed_observations) from screen_counts) min_screen_completed_observations,
 (select count(*) from fam_counts) pre_cut_families,
 (select min(observations) from fam_counts) min_family_observations_all,
 (select min(completed_observations) from fam_counts) min_family_completed_observations,
 (select payload from receipt) receipt_payload,
